fusions.name: Marking Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses a scrap of mesh that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: A weapon strike against an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds as the mesh closes on it; it is [Inescapable] for 4 seconds and cannot teleport away.

fusions.name: Long Pursuit
fusions.desc: Pays out your mesh for the chase: for 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Quarry Tiring
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health, the quarry your mesh is closing on.
